slots.text: A fleet belonging to Ptolemaic is lost at sea.
Gaul sues Rome for peace and;
Gaul ends all current trading agreements.
Bithynia sues Seleucid for peace and;
Bithynia ends all current trading agreements.
Yatrib defects from Ptolemaic to Seleucid.
Macedonia finishes a new fleet at Amphipolis.
Celtiberia and Carthage have agreed to end their war.
